answer_1.quote: Given samples of prefixes and suffixes from the original pre‑training data of the language model, we use a prefix as input for the language model to generate the suffix; ... we aim to have the fine‑tuned LM paraphrase the suffix as a way to mitigate memorization.
answer_1.outputs: Paraphrased suffixes (generated continuations) produced by the fine‑tuned language model

answer_2.quote: we compute the negative BERTScore to measure the dissimilarity between the true suffix and generated suffix, the dissimilarity scores are then regarded as a reward signal ... we also use negative SacreBLEU as a metric to quantify memorization and measure forgetting; perplexity is used to assess fluency of generated suffixes.
